features.text: CONTACT-READY HINGED SUPPORT: Concealed, removable hinges provide medial/lateral stability for wrestling and combat sports.
OPEN-BACK WRAP DESIGN: Easy on/off between matches with breathable compression for active use.
NEOPRENE COMFORT: Consistent warmth and support without restricting explosive movement.
LOW-PROFILE FIT: Slides under athletic gear while maintaining full range of motion.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PDAC APPROVED L1812, L1810: Eligible for insurance reimbursement (check with your provider).
